Text: The Journey of Faith
Heading: A Spiral, Not a Ladder
Text: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We receive, question, seek, rebuild, …
blocks.value: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We receive, question, seek, rebuild, embody, and awaken - often more than once. No stage is a rank, and no stage makes anyone more loved by God.

blocks.label: Text: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change - not God's…
blocks.value: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change - not God's relationship to us. Jesus remains at the center of the journey.

Text: Where You Are
Heading: This is a real and worthy beginning.
blocks.value: This is a real and worthy beginning.

blocks.label: Text: Faith often arrives before we know how to name it. We learn prayers from…
blocks.value: Faith often arrives before we know how to name it. We learn prayers from others, inherit stories, attend gatherings, and absorb a picture of God through people we trust. These can become roots.

blocks.label: Text: One common risk is confusing what is familiar with what is fully alive. …
blocks.value: One common risk is confusing what is familiar with what is fully alive. A faith can be sincere and still be mostly borrowed. The invitation is not to reject your inheritance, but to become conscious of it - what gives life, what needs deeper understanding, and how Jesus is becoming personally known.

blocks.label: Heading: You began by receiving, not achieving.
blocks.value: You began by receiving, not achieving.

blocks.label: Text: Grace was already moving toward you through people, stories, Scripture, …
blocks.value: Grace was already moving toward you through people, stories, Scripture, and community before you knew how to name it.

blocks.label: Heading: Belonging is a genuine gift.
Text: Shared faith can give language, identity, practices, and a place to begi…
blocks.value: Shared faith can give language, identity, practices, and a place to begin. These roots deserve gratitude.

blocks.label: Heading: Questions need not threaten the foundation.
blocks.value: Questions need not threaten the foundation.

blocks.label: Text: A living faith can become more personal without becoming disloyal. Curio…
blocks.value: A living faith can become more personal without becoming disloyal. Curiosity can deepen what you received.

blocks.label: Heading: Practice helps faith become yours.
Text: Prayer, Scripture, gratitude, and honest conversation move faith from so…
blocks.value: Prayer, Scripture, gratitude, and honest conversation move faith from something around you to a life you inhabit.
